origin: Plan §4.1 OBL-02 — future hooks for quitting, loan repayment and eviction drain without performing the event they promise
player_capability: choosing the response that schedules the hook; no capability to prevent, defer, or settle it
consumers: src/sim/modules/responses/responsesModule.ts applyPendingEntry — memory draft or zero-weight cause; no domain mutation

origin: Plan §4.1 OBL-04 — supplier credit and a weekly invoice list are surfaced, but nothing produces an invoice or pays one

origin: Plan §4.1 OBL-05 — Easy advertises slower decay but difficulty only edits day-zero values and is not stored in state

autonomous_trigger: none — no ongoing rule reads the selected ruleset

ui_surfaces: title/new-game difficulty picker; src/reports/glossary.ts difficulty terms

origin: Plan §4.1 OBL-06 — Quick Day is advertised in Help and the Day screen, but its zero-card eligibility rule is unreachable

origin: Plan §4.1 OBL-07 — queued-action Help states actions run at the start of the next sim day, reversing the real same-day behavior

consumers: players reading Help

notes: Split across the arc: Phase 1 §1.4 adds grouped causes and collection-element targets, Phase 8 closes the rumour half, Phase 10 the mastery half.

origin: Plan §4.1 OBL-09 — tavern nicknames are displayed from rumours tagged `nickname`, but no simulation path ever creates one
producer: none — no generator emits a nickname-tagged rumour
consumers: src/reports/worldOverviewProjection.ts (filters rumours tagged `nickname`)
tests: none — the consumer is covered, the producer does not exist

origin: Plan §4.2 — cash must respond meaningfully to persistent quality and reputation collapse

consumers: src/sim/modules/weekly; src/sim/modules/monthly accounting

origin: Plan §4.2 — service must model capacity, queues, throughput, patience, abandonment, and staff allocation

consumers: src/sim/modules/weekly; issue seed generators; pressures

notes: Plan §4.1 — deterministic within-service substeps inside Segment B; the least granular model that creates real bottlenecks.

origin: Plan §4.2 — areas must model usable capacity, spatial relationships, construction, materials, hazards, and upgrades

autonomous_trigger: daily area drift; damage from incidents
consumers: src/sim/modules/service; pressures; issue seed generators
notes: Carries OBL-01. Areas have no capacity or adjacency today; propagation edges must each have a physical reason (plan §2.4).

origin: Plan §4.2 — staff must have schedules, availability, relationships, development, labor terms, absence, burnout outcomes, and autonomous separation

ui_surfaces: tavern overview staff block; staff drilldowns

origin: Plan §4.2 — customers and regulars must make service-level choices rather than existing only as aggregate demand and descriptive individuals

consumers: src/sim/modules/service; memories; attribution
ui_surfaces: world overview regulars; daily report service block
notes: Favorite stock must affect behavior rather than remain descriptive metadata (plan §4.3).

origin: Plan §4.2 — suppliers must operate an actual order to delivery to invoice chain
autonomous_trigger: supplier reliability drift; market condition rotation
consumers: src/sim/modules/stock; weekly report
ui_surfaces: world overview suppliers; weekly invoice block
notes: Carries OBL-04. Reliability rolls must occur on real orders (plan §6.2).

origin: Plan §4.2 — inspections, rent, loans, arrears, and eviction must form real external-obligation lifecycles

player_capability: faction- and culture-facing response slots; policies
consumers: customers forecast; issue seed generators; attribution
notes: Replace pure threshold +1/-1 drift with decisions: support, requests, boycotts, sponsorships, protection (plan §8.1).

origin: Plan §4.2 — notable NPCs and rivals must be capable of visible autonomous moves

ui_surfaces: world overview NPC block; monthly report rival line

consumers: attribution; identity; issue seed generators

origin: Plan §4.2 — beliefs and attribution must alter decisions, not only generate explanation

consumers: reports and card text; no decision rule reads it

origin: Plan §4.2 — expeditions must contain decisions and risks between commission and final resolution

notes: Expedition seeds must stay stable from commission through resolution (plan §9.3).

origin: Plan §4.2 — local arcs must progress through state and actor behavior rather than mostly age once per month
consumers: issue seed generators; customers; reports
notes: The catalog must collectively exercise eight materially different arc shapes (plan §9.2).

player_capability: house rules, policies, rebrand response slots
consumers: reports and card text; little downstream decision use
notes: Carries OBL-09. Identity labels summarize evidence; they must not replace it (plan §10.3).
